name: Miyoshi (Aichi, Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Miyoshi city emblem in navy: a disc crossed by white strokes forming a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Miyoshi, a city in Aichi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 31 March 2005; the emblem dates from 28 February 1959.

features.role: Miyoshi city emblem — a disc crossed by white strokes forming a stylised character
